decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler stays close to the core offer and is cheap to keep listed, and two years of results have not shown that its value is unlikely to be realized.
The air cooled condenser shares production and sales resources with the core business, so the option is still worth holding at low cost while industrial demand develops.
This second condenser overlaps with Product B and could later be consolidated, but holding it costs little and no evidence yet justifies abandoning it.
The tube liner is a low-cost repair add-on that fits the growing lifecycle service strategy and still has upside in maintenance markets.
The customized air cooler line with several models fits the firm's integrated solution focus and offers several paths for further investment.
The tube end repair inserts support the spare parts and service business at minimal holding cost, so keeping the option open is justified.
